items.excerpt: Meta has begun rolling out an improved Muse Spark AI model to its Ray-Ban Display smart glasses, its only screen-equipped pair. The upgraded on-glasses assistant is described as snappier, more natural, and far better at following what the wearer is doing.

A review of the fifth-gen Oura smart ring, 40% smaller than before, with the built-in Oura Advisor AI delivering personalized health guidance from the wearer's biometric data. It makes the case for on-body AI wellness coaching over always-on companion gadgets.

A hands-on with iOS 27's rebuilt Apple Intelligence Siri praises its expanded on-device knowledge, conversational interface, personal-context awareness, and unified in-app actions across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It reads as the first Siri that finally delivers on Apple's AI promises.

Amazon's new Alexa+ developer toolkit lets smart-home device makers plug their full feature sets directly into the AI assistant instead of burying them in separate apps. Bosch, Whirlpool, iRobot, Govee, Yale Home, and Eufy are the first partners onboard.

Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 arrives wider, thinner, and lighter, with a redesigned aspect ratio and Gemini-powered on-device AI at its center, positioning the foldable against Apple's upcoming first foldable and iPhone Ultra.
